responsibilities.quote: Students are responsible for ensuring that all submitted work meets the University standards for academic integrity and for avoiding academic misconduct in all its forms including but not limited to the examples listed above: cheating, plagiarism, contract cheating, impersonation, and the unethical use of Gen(AI).
Students are obliged to uphold academic integrity and adhere to this Policy

The University will provide guidance on the ethical use of GenAI through CIRTL, the Skills Centre, and/or the Library. Students must familiarise themselves with this guidance, which may change and update during the course of the academic year and their programme.

The University is responsible for establishing and updating the policy and standards for academic integrity with reference to national and international standards.
